units: metres, glTF axes of aura-body.glb (+Y up, figure faces +Z, anatomical left +X)
mapping: imageX = (x - left) / (right - left) * width; imageY = (top - y) / (top - bottom) * height; pixel (0,0) is the top-left corner

front.imageXIncreasesWith: +X (model +X, the anatomical left, is on the image's right)

back.imageXIncreasesWith: -X (model +X, the anatomical left, is on the image's left)
